case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels). Need: 23700 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 14 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200018. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for explaining the cost drivers behind your quotation. We recognise the rising alloy and processing costs; our opening proposal reflects our assessment of the commercial package, including delivery performance.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).

The longer agreement offers continuity for your account planning and a commercial rationale for internal pricing approval. We are flexible on payment terms, including an option retaining your standard terms; please choose the package that works best for you.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.21 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We value our relationship with Werdenfels and welcome your considered response.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We acknowledge your feedback regarding our delivery performance and appreciate your interest in a 24-month agreement.
For a contract of this duration, we must include an AS-14404 index clause to manage material volatility.
Under these terms, maintaining our standard 30 days net payment, we can offer a revised price of €5.60 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for lowering your price and checking the delivery record. We recognise that this does not change your cost calculation and that a longer agreement requires protection against alloy volatility.

We have made a modest price concession and are flexible on the index deadband, but ask for a further base-price reduction in return. All options include your requested alloy adjustment; Option C removes the deadband for closer cost tracking in exchange for the lowest base price, so please tell us which works best.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.28 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.23 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 3% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.16 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your openness and hope this explicit trade gives you a clear rationale for internal approval.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. 

We appreciate your flexibility regarding the index clause and your modest price concession. While we note your options regarding the deadband, the proposed base prices remain too low for us to accept. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. 

We must therefore maintain our offer of €5.60 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 90 days payment and the AS-14404 index clause. For total clarity, our Angebot stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Franz Seidl,

Thank you for the price reduction and for explaining your alloy, processing and labour cost drivers. Your request for supporting figures is fair; our proposal is a commercial trade for continuity and alloy protection, not a calculation showing that your costs have fallen.

We are making a further modest price concession and ask for a base-price reduction in exchange for the alloy adjustment you requested. We are flexible on the deadband: Option B provides that protection without a deadband in exchange for the lowest base price; please tell us which package works best for your pricing committee.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.34 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 5% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option B: EUR 5.23 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 0% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.
Option C: EUR 5.30 per unit, index clause on AS-14404 (45% material share, 3% deadband, base 2026-08), payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement.

We appreciate your careful consideration and want to keep this account worthwhile for both companies.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for reaching out to us again. We acknowledge your revised proposal and appreciate your flexibility regarding the index deadband. 

We have already taken that quality record data into account. However, as you noted, our underlying costs have not decreased, which means we cannot justify a further reduction of the base price. 

We therefore maintain our offer of €5.60 per unit for a 24-month agreement with 90 days payment and the AS-14404 index clause. For full clarity, our complete Angebot stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We truly value our ongoing business relationship and look forward to hearing from you soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
